title: Most babies keep hold of a toy placed in the hand by about 4 months
summary: Most babies hold a toy when it is placed in the hand by about 4 months, the US CDC says.
body: The CDC 4-month movement list says holds a toy when you put it in his hand. The toy is placed in the hand. The line does not say the baby has to reach out and grab it. The page groups this with what most babies do by four months. Keeping that grip is one hand item on an American checklist, not a full test of hands, and other countries' checklists differ.

sources.title: Milestones by 4 Months
sources.author: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
sources.note: Movement line: Holds a toy when you put it in his hand.
